prompts.prompt: In Databricks, for a Delta table to support the UniForm feature that generates Iceberg metadata alongside Delta metadata, what minimum Delta writer protocol version must the table have? Answer with just the number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/databricks/references/architecture.md - UniForm (Universal Format) Requirements: Requires Delta reader version 3 and writer version 7.

prompts.prompt: In Databricks Delta Lake, a checkpoint Parquet file is written to the transaction log after how many commits by default? Answer with the exact number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/databricks/references/architecture.md - Transaction Log section: Checkpoint files (.checkpoint.parquet) are written every 10 commits (configurable).

prompts.prompt: In Databricks Delta Lake, what is the default file retention period used by the VACUUM command before unreferenced data files become eligible for deletion? Answer with the exact number of days.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/databricks/references/best-practices.md - VACUUM and Retention section: Default retention is 7 days (delta.deletedFileRetentionDuration = interval 7 days).
